value.exercise_1: Lunges - Start standing with feet shoulder-width apart, take a step forward with the right leg, bend the knee, ensuring it doesn't extend past the foot. Push up to starting position. Repeat with left leg. Complete 3 sets of 10 reps.
value.exercise_2: Pushups - Start in a plank position, bend elbows to lower, then extend back up. Complete 3 sets of as many reps as possible. Modified version available on knees.
value.exercise_3: Squats - Stand straight, feet wider than shoulder-width, push hips back and bend knees. Drop until thighs are parallel to the ground. Complete 3 sets of 20 reps.
value.exercise_4: Standing Overhead Press - Stand with dumbbells, push weights overhead until arms fully extended. Complete 3 sets of 12 reps.
value.exercise_5: Dumbbell Rows - Using a dumbbell in each hand, bend forward and pull weights toward the chest. Complete 3 sets of 10 reps.
value.exercise_6: Single-leg Deadlifts - Stand with a dumbbell, hinge at hips, lower the dumbbell and lift the leg behind. Complete 3 sets of 10-12 reps per side.
value.exercise_7: Burpees - Start standing, squat down, pop legs back into pushup position, jump feet back to hands. Stand and jump up. Complete 3 sets of 10 reps.
value.exercise_8: Side Planks - Lie on side, prop up with forearm, lift hips and knees off the ground. Complete 3 sets of 10-15 reps on each side.
value.exercise_9: Planks - Begin in pushup position, maintain tight core and straight body. Complete 2-3 sets of 30-second holds.
value.exercise_10: Glute Bridges - Lie on the floor with knees bent, push through heels to raise hips. Complete 10-12 reps for 3 sets.
value.progressive_overload: Increase difficulty by adding 5 more reps, increasing weight, or switching to time-under-tension training.
